title: Operating states of the status LED
body_md:
The source distinguishes nine states. Each is represented by a flashing sequence and a colour:

| Indication | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| flashes red and yellow alternately | network scan, no destination numbers available |
| flashes red | network scan or no mobile network signal |
| continuous yellow light | connecting with the modem |
| continuous red light | SIM card missing or defective |
| flashes red and green alternately | SIM PIN not deactivated |
| flashes yellow | signed in, last text message could not be sent |
| continuous green light | Pro-finder is receiving or sending a text message |
| flashes yellow and green alternately | signed in, no destination numbers available |
| flashes green | signed in, destination numbers available |

Once installation and programming are complete, the indicator flashes green during normal operation.

change_reason: Extracted from the English source page itself, not translated from the German master, and cross-read against the German page 18: all nine states match in order, colour sequence and meaning, as does the closing box. The English source contains two typesetting errors that do not change the meaning: a missing space and an unclosed bracket (DSC-018); both are corrected in this extraction and the correction is named here rather than made silently. Crucially, the nine states are distinguished **solely** by colour and flashing rhythm, with no text alternative in the graphic – which is why the meaning is spelled out.
